gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed glioblastoma per 2021 WHO classification progression according to RANO criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: A Study With L19TNF in Combination With Lomustine in Patients With Glioblastoma at Progression or Recurrence

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: patients with glioblastoma at any progression/recurrence (first and later)

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetics assessment of L19TNF through blood sampling

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic information of the combination of L19TNF and lomustine at different dose levels

role_evidence.quote: A Dose Optimization Study for L19TNF in Combination With Lomustine in Patients With Glioblastoma at Progression or Recurrence

agents.drug_class_hint: antibody-cytokine fusion protein (L19 antibody fused to TNF)

role_evidence.quote: Each arm has a different combination of L19TNF (7 μg/kg or 10 μg/kg or 13 μg/kg) and lomustine at different dose levels (90 or 110 mg/m2).

source_quote.quote: patients will be randomized in accordance with the following strata:

coder_notes: Lomustine dose differs between arms (90 or 110 mg/m2), so coded established_therapy_experiment per rule 6 / R2; L19TNF is the only investigational agent. Eligibility also requires 'MGMT promotor status known' (status known, not a specific status), so not coded as an eligibility biomarker. Sponsor is Philogen S.p.A. (industry). Arm labels are Arm A to F, all with dose combinations; no control arm.
